slides.title: Sunday pancakes
slides.text: On Sunday, Lucia and Gus make pancakes. First they mix eggs, flour and milk. Then Lucia heats the pan. Next she pours some of the mix into the pan. After two minutes she turns the pancake over. Finally she puts honey and fruit on top. Gus says it is the best breakfast ever.

slides.title: Medidas
slides.text: Receitas americanas usam 'cups' (xícaras), 'tablespoons' (colheres de sopa) e 'teaspoons' (chá). No Reino Unido usam gramas e mililitros.
